description.p: Publii is a desktop content management system that produces static websites. Content lives on your own machine in a local database, and the site is rendered to plain HTML before it is uploaded. There is no database, no admin login and no server-side code on the published site.

Writing happens in a block editor, a rich text editor or plain Markdown, with a live preview of the rendered page. Themes are configured through a graphical options panel rather than by editing template files.
Publii can upload a finished site over:

ul.li: FTP and SFTP, with password or key authentication
Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage
GitHub Pages, GitLab Pages and Netlify
Plain Git, or a downloadable archive for manual upload

description.p: Only changed files are transferred on each upload. Generated sites include a sitemap, Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata, responsive images with optional WebP conversion, and an optional cookie consent banner.
